options.title: Organize Your Tasks
options.description: Choose how you'd like to organize your Hopla tasks in Home Assistant

data.show_due_in: Days ahead to show upcoming tasks
data.show_no_due_date: Show tasks with no due date
data.create_project_lists: Create individual task lists per project
data.create_assignee_lists: Create individual task lists per person

data_description.parent_users: Home Assistant users who may approve, edit tasks and spend points. Leave empty to let everyone do it.
data_description.parent_pin: Four digits that open parent mode for two minutes on the family tablet. Leave empty to keep the current code.

error.invalid_pin: The parent code must be exactly four digits.

parent_required.message: Only a parent can do this. Open parent mode with the parent code.

pin_locked.message: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {minutes} min.

pin_not_set.message: No parent code is set. A parent can choose one in the Hopla integration options.

no_chrono.message: No speed bonus was started on this task.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Complete a Hopla task, optionally for a given member. A task that needs approval waits for a parent instead, and the response returns pending_approval true.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to complete

completed_by.name: Done by
completed_by.description: The Hopla user ID of the member who did the task (optional)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Create a Hopla task. Parents only.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: Due date in RFC 3339 format (optional, for example 2026-07-28T18:00:00Z)

created_by.name: Created by
created_by.description: The Hopla user ID of the member who created the task (optional)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Update a Hopla task. Archived tasks stay archived unless Reactivate is on. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to update

name.name: Name
name.description: The new name of the task (optional)

description.name: Description
description.description: The new description (optional, an empty text clears it)

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: The new due date in RFC 3339 format (optional, for example 2026-07-28T18:00:00Z)

force_unarchive.name: Reactivate
force_unarchive.description: Reactivate the task if it is archived (optional, off by default)

assigned_to.name: Assigned to
assigned_to.description: The Hopla user ID of an eligible member, or null in YAML for anyone

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

skip_task.name: Skip task
skip_task.description: Skip a recurring task to its next occurrence without recording a completion. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to skip

completed_by.name: Skipped by
completed_by.description: The Hopla user ID to record the skip for (optional)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

delete_task.name: Delete task
delete_task.description: Delete a Hopla task. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to delete

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

complete_assigned_task.name: Complete as the assigned member
complete_assigned_task.description: Complete a task for its current assignee, or for the API token owner when anyone can do it.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to complete

completed_by.name: Done by
completed_by.description: For an "everyone together" task: the member who did it (optional)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

postpone_task.name: Move to next occurrence
postpone_task.description: Move a task to its next scheduled occurrence without completing it. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to move

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

approve_task.name: Approve task
approve_task.description: Approve a completion waiting for approval. The task is completed and its points go to the member who did it. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task waiting for approval

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: For a task done several times a day: the slot of today, from 0 for the first (optional)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

reject_task.name: Reject task
reject_task.description: Reject a completion waiting for approval. No points are given and the task is due again. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task waiting for approval

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: For a task done several times a day: the slot of today, from 0 for the first (optional)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

redeem_reward.name: Redeem reward
redeem_reward.description: Spend a member's points on a reward. From a parent it is approved at once; from anyone else, such as the family tablet, it becomes a request for a parent to approve.

reward_id.name: Reward ID
reward_id.description: The ID of the reward (see the rewards sensor)

user_id.name: Member
user_id.description: The Hopla user ID whose points are spent (optional, the API token owner by default)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

approve_reward.name: Approve reward request
approve_reward.description: Approve a member's reward request and spend their points. Parents only.

redemption_id.name: Request ID
redemption_id.description: The ID of the request (see the requests of the rewards sensor)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

reject_reward.name: Reject reward request
reject_reward.description: Reject a member's reward request. No points are spent. Parents only.

redemption_id.name: Request ID
redemption_id.description: The ID of the request (see the requests of the rewards sensor)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

unlock_parent_mode.name: Open parent mode
unlock_parent_mode.description: Open parent mode for two minutes with the four-digit parent code, for example on the family tablet.

pin.name: Parent code
pin.description: The four-digit code set in the integration options

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

lock_parent_mode.name: Close parent mode
lock_parent_mode.description: Close parent mode before the two minutes are up.

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

adjust_points.name: Bonus or penalty
adjust_points.description: Give a member extra points, or take some away. Only for parents. A penalty lowers the points earned, and so the rank, but never takes the balance below zero.

user_id.name: Member
user_id.description: The Hopla ID of the member

points.name: Points
points.description: Positive for a bonus, negative for a penalty (leave empty with a preset)

preset_id.name: Preset
preset_id.description: The ID of a bonus or penalty preset (see the bonuses and penalties sensor), instead of points

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why, shown in the points history (optional, the preset name by default)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

catch_up_slot.name: Catch up a slot
catch_up_slot.description: Tick a slot of today of a task done several times a day for a child: the slot open now, or a missed one until midnight. Its points go to the child. Parents only.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task done several times a day

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: The slot of today, from 0 for the first

completed_by.name: Done by
completed_by.description: The user ID of the child who did it (optional, the task's assignee by default)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

get_points_history.name: Points history
get_points_history.description: A page of a member's points history, newest first: tasks, bonuses, penalties and rewards. Anyone may read it.

user_id.name: Member
user_id.description: The Hopla ID of the member

limit.name: Rows
limit.description: How many rows to return (20 by default)

before.name: Before
before.description: The ID of a row: only older rows are returned, to page back

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

set_family_timezone.name: Family time zone
set_family_timezone.description: Move the family to another time zone, for a holiday: its tasks keep their time of day. Only for parents.

timezone.name: Time zone
timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/Lisbon

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

start_chrono.name: Start a speed bonus
start_chrono.description: Give extra points to whoever does a task (or a copy of it) in the next minutes, once per child. Starting again replaces the running one. Only for parents.

task_id.name: Task
task_id.description: The Hopla ID of the task

points.name: Extra points
points.description: Added to the task's points (5 by default)

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the speed bonus lasts (15 by default)

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)

stop_chrono.name: Stop a speed bonus
stop_chrono.description: End the speed bonus started on a task before its time. Only for parents.

task_id.name: Task
task_id.description: The Hopla ID of the task

config_entry_id.name: Hopla integration
config_entry_id.description: The Hopla integration to use (optional, the first one by default)
